Rank 1 2.5s Cast Holy Light 40%

We have a Troll Warrior Guide on our Discord. Here's how much Regeneration you can have. You can get about 3-6 more if you do 8 Spirit on Head Legs but I don't think that's better than 200 Health unless it's a very long fight.

Spirit Formula
(Current Spirit) Example, Best in Slot Base
84 **x 1.26** = 105.84
105.84 **- 22.6** = 83.24
Troll Racial Add 20%:
83.24 **x .2** = (16.648 + 83.24 = 99.888)
In Combat Regeneration:
99.888 **x .25** = 24.972

You heal for 24.9 In Combat every 2 seconds and 99.8 Out of Combat every 2 Seconds.

Rogues and Troll Warrior tank. Rogues need time for threat but can get 100% Dodge. Troll Warrior can get a lot of Health and 30-60 Healing every 2 Seconds in Combat and have the highest threat spamming Battleshout.

Warriors can do without all of those buffs but perform best with them.

Rogues can ping pong enemies and all kind of tank a little.
